# Udyog Growth

> Udyog Growth (udyoggrowth.com) is an Indian consultancy for government subsidies
> (PMFME 35% subsidy, PMKSY, PLI, PMEGP, CGTMSE), GST notice replies and litigation
> (DRC-01/DRC-06, ASMT-10, ITC mismatch, audits, appeals), GeM registration and
> government tender bidding, with on-ground departmental representation.

## Pages
- https://udyoggrowth.com/pmfme-subsidy-consultant/ : PMFME 35% subsidy up to Rs 10 lakh, DPR, ODOP, SHG/FPO projects, MoFPI schemes
- https://udyoggrowth.com/gst-notice-reply/ : DRC-01 reply in DRC-06, DRC-01C (7-day), ASMT-10, ITC mismatch GSTR-2B vs 3B, Sec 73/74, audits, Bihar GST, appeals
- https://udyoggrowth.com/gem-registration-tender-bidding/ : GeM registration 3-5 days, catalogue, vendor assessment, OEM panel, bids/RA, tenders, Bihar govt tenders
- https://udyoggrowth.com/msme-schemes/ : Udyam, PMEGP 15-35% margin money, CGTMSE collateral-free credit, ZED, MSE-CDP
- https://udyoggrowth.com/bihar-gst-consultant/ : Bihar GST assessments, audits, ITC disputes, appeals, physical representation
- https://udyoggrowth.com/bihar-government-tenders/ : Bihar govt tenders - Panchayati Raj, IT Dept, Urban Housing, bid lifecycle
- https://udyoggrowth.com/gst-notice-first-48-hours/ : What to do when a GST notice arrives - DRC-01/DRC-01C/ASMT-10, deadlines, 5 mistakes

## Why clients choose Udyog Growth
Weekly working presence with the same departments in Delhi, NCR and Bihar;
files prepared in the exact format each office expects; in-person follow-up till decision.
